# alarmist v0.4.2 - Table of Contents

> Manage, subscribe and create alarms compatible with Erlang's built in Alarm Handler

## Pages

- [Alarmist](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Alarmist](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/Alarmist.md): Alarm handler and more
- [Alarmist.Alarm](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/Alarmist.Alarm.md): DSL for defining managed alarms
- [Alarmist.Event](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/Alarmist.Event.md): Struct sent to subscribers on property changes
- [Alarmist.Handler](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/Alarmist.Handler.md): Alarm handler

- [Alarmist.Ops](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/Alarmist.Ops.md): Alarm operations for use with `alarm_if`

- [Alarmist.RemedyWorker](https://alarmist.hexdocs.pm/Alarmist.RemedyWorker.md): Remedy callback runner
